messages:
jordan-sales: Pillar Health wants a short POC next week: sustain 300 qps, p95/p99 targets, coldstart checks, and CMK for embeddings. Need runbook + ballpark pricing.

alex-eng: Propose hosted vs dedicated profiles. Hosted easier but higher per-token; dedicated better unit cost steady-state.

maria-ops: What are avg sequence lengths?

jordan-sales: Sample: ~220 tokens in, ~130 out, 75% session reuse.

alex-eng: That favors prefix caching. Token rate ~105k tok/s; at ~12k tok/s per GPU => ~9 GPUs with headroom.

samir-sre: For tail SLOs enable continuous batching cap 20ms, KV cache, multi-AZ. Keep standby pre-warm.

kori-qa: Draft run: 30m steady @300 qps, 10m 3x burst, 5 coldstart cycles, KMS rotation test. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, GPU util, KMS latency.

jordan-sales: Procurement wants 12mo dedicated quote + 1mo hosted PoC price.

maria-ops: Ballpark placeholders: Dedicated (9 GPUs reserved): "$85k/mo"; Hosted PoC (1mo): "$28k". Finalize in runbook.

alex-eng: Note cost levers: 4-bit quant, smaller window, caching/session affinity.

samir-sre: kms-bot: "KMS STATUS: CMK available on Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports envelope encryption; for customer-managed CMK recommend Dedicated/Private."

jordan-sales: I'll update Pillar and loop in security/procurement. Kori will post results after run. :thumbsup:
